capacity_gross_kwh.notes: CarExpert/ArenaEV: 92.5 kWh gross; Wikipedia: the 2026 facelift GranTurismo and GranCabrio Folgore keep the same 92.5 kWh pack.

preconditioning.notes: EV Database search excerpt only (page 429): "Preconditioning Possible: Yes; Automatically using Navigation: Yes". Not read on a Maserati page; stated for GranTurismo, applied to GranCabrio as the same hardware. Owner question.

dc_max_kw.notes: ArenaEV: up to 270 kW via CCS; CarExpert 270 kW; The Charge Port US 270 kW for 2024-2026.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: same hardware in another market. CarExpert, ArenaEV and Wikipedia state a 22 kW onboard charger (Type 2, three-phase) and no source shows a US difference. Caveat: US 240 V single-phase supply limits the delivered rate to about 10-11.5 kW (EPA 240 V times: 9 h for 83 kWh GranTurismo, 11 h for 95 kWh Grecale); owner may prefer 11 kW.
